test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The average age of a class of 50 boys is 12.9 years. It increases to 13 years when one new boy joins the class. The age (in years) of the new boy is ______.
solution:
**Given:**

Average age of 50 boys = 12.9 years

**Formula used:**

Total age = Average age × Number of boys

**Calculation:**

Total age of 50 boys = 12.9 × 50 = 645 years

When one new boy joins, the new average age = 13 years

Total number of boys = 50 + 1 = 51

Total age with new boy = 13 × 51 = 663 years

Age of the new boy = Total age with new boy - Total age of 50 boys

⇒ Age of the new boy = 663 - 645 = 18 years

**∴ The age of the new boy is 18 years.**
